faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger suitable for Gas line check valve plunger?
faq.a: Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address gas delivery operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for gas line check requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. gas line check components require Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for gas line check application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet gas line check specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
